text: That is helpful; the combination of position-dependent vertigo and age-related hearing loss strongly suggests an inner ear issue. Videonystagmography: Normal vestibular response with the exception of response elicited during Dix-Hallpike maneuver, consistent with BPPV. MRI Brain: No evidence of central lesions or infarcts that would suggest central causes of vertigo.
